0022600223.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-7, 11th in the West) host the Brooklyn Nets (2-8, 13th in the East) in the Pelicans' 12th game of the season, with New Orleans on a three-game losing streak and 1-4 on the road. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with the Pelicans winning the most recent meeting 116-113 in New Orleans on January 14, 2026. New Orleans is without Yves Missi (out, knee bruise), and Trendon Watford (ankle), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis) and Zion Williamson (rest) are day-to-day game-time decisions, while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (out, leg bruise) and has Mikel Brown Jr. listed as day-to-day with rest.
